summary: Backend-only testing of Plataforma DICOM Médica. Wrote pytest suite covering auth (register/login/logout/me), doctors, studies (upload/list/download/delete with role-based access), and stats. 24/24 tests pass including Fernet encrypt/decrypt bytes round-trip.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec. Browsers will reject credentialed requests when Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*'. Should be set to an explicit origin list (e.g., the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / frontend origin). Not blocking backend tests (requests lib ignores CORS) but will impact frontend cookie flow.
Cookie set with secure=False. OK for dev but must be True in production (site is served over https).
No brute-force lockout after N failed attempts (auth playbook expects 5-attempt lockout). Currently unlimited attempts.
No password policy beyond min_length=6. Acceptable for MVP.
Seed is not idempotent for password changes — if ADMIN_PASSWORD changes in .env, existing admin is not updated. Minor for MVP since credentials unchanged.

action_items: Consider replacing CORS_ORIGINS='*' with the explicit frontend origin to make credentialed cookie auth work correctly from browser.
Add brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (5 fails → temporary lock) per auth playbook.
Make seed_admin idempotent on password change (update password_hash if ADMIN_PASSWORD differs).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~400 LOC — acceptable but future growth should split into routers (auth, studies, doctors).
MongoDB _id correctly excluded in all reads.
bcrypt hashes produced via bcrypt.gensalt() (format $2b$...) — correct.
Fernet encryption/decryption verified: downloaded bytes == uploaded bytes.
Role-based access on upload/list/download/delete working as specified.
Email normalisation to lowercase is consistent (register & login lowercase input).
No rate limiting / no CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints; rely on SameSite=Lax cookie. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
test_credentials: admin@medicos.com / admin123 (seed medico). Dynamic TEST_ users created per run.
seed_data_creation: Each test module creates a TEST_pac_<hex>, TEST_cli_<hex>, TEST_med_<hex> user. Studies are uploaded and the test suite self-cleans at the end (deletes uploaded studies). Users persist in DB (not critical, prefixed with TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints in review_request validated. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_dicom_platform.py uses requests.Session for cookie-based auth. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_dicom_platform.py -v. Minor findings are non-blocking for backend but CORS='*' + credentials will break browser cookie auth — check in frontend testing phase.
